terms.gloss: a theory, an explanation, a system of ideas
evidence: Cic. Rep. 1.25: haec nova et ignōta ratiō
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “a theory, doctrine, or system based upon reason”. What the theory holds follows in an accusative and infinitive (Cic. Rep. 1.25).

terms.gloss: a conjecture, a theory that cannot be proved
evidence: Cic. Att. 14.22.1: nē nihil conjectūrā aberrem

phrases.latin: erat enim tum haec nova et ignōta ratiō, sōlem lūnae oppositū solēre dēficere
phrases.english: for this was then a new and unknown theory: that the sun is eclipsed when the moon is set against it

sources: Lewis & Short: ratio · Lewis & Short: conjectura
Cicero (Rep. 1.25, Att. 14.22.1) checked against the Perseus Latin texts (9 November 2026).
